headline: Our best tips for using the iPhone Duo
summary: The iPhone Duo is a fundamentally new device with a unique learning curve. It represents a significant design change from previous iPhones. Tips help users master its distinct features and interface.

headline: Apple revives the original iPod as an Apple Music easter egg
summary: Apple Music's 404 page features a virtual recreation of the first-gen iPod. This hidden easter egg is stocked with early 2000s music. Users discovered the nostalgic throwback on social media.

headline: People are vibe coding their way to better TVs
summary: Users are "vibe coding" TVs with LLMs and open-source tools. This removes ads, tracking, and bloat for faster, personalized OS. Some even completely redesign their TV homescreens for fun.

headline: Netflix can’t fire its way out of this downward spiral
summary: Netflix announced 1,000 layoffs and executive oustings. Co-CEOs tried to reassure investors despite significant cutbacks. The company is downsizing product, tech, and legal departments amidst changes.

headline: Grand Theft Auto V – The Legacy Review
summary: GTA V, launched in 2013, was remarkably future-proof. Its subsequent ports remain benchmarks for open-world action games. The game's enduring quality highlights its initial groundbreaking design.

headline: Canadian Politician Wants the Government to Bail Out Mass Effect Developer BioWare
summary: A Canadian opposition leader wants government intervention for BioWare. Avi Lewis aims to secure a bailout for the Mass Effect developer. The politician believes the studio requires financial support.

headline: How The Infernal Hulk vs. The Avengers Sets Up a Massive 2027 Crossover
summary: An exclusive preview details "The Infernal Hulk vs. The Avengers #1". This comic is the final setup for Marvel's 2027 "Hulk War" crossover. It builds anticipation for the "Infernal Rage" event.

headline: PlayStation Is Offering $40 Off PS5 Refurb Bundles Ahead of GTA 6
summary: PlayStation is offering $40 off refurbished PS5 console and DualSense bundles. This deal provides up to $155 in total savings. The offer comes ahead of the highly anticipated GTA 6 release.

headline: Meghan says she was informed about 'disturbing allegations' against her father in 2018
summary: Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, issued a statement regarding her father. She was informed in 2018 of "disturbing allegations" against Thomas Markle. Reports suggest her father is being investigated over child sex abuse images.

headline: Watch: BBC presenter battles strong winds as storm hits Newquay
summary: BBC weather presenter Simon King reported from Newquay. He battled strong winds as a storm made landfall. The broadcast captured the "full force" of the storm.

headline: Deadly shooting near Paris investigated as 'crime of terrorism', minister says
summary: A deadly shooting near Paris killed one and wounded five. The suspected gunman has been apprehended by authorities. The incident is being investigated as a "crime of terrorism."

headline: Burnham suggests stocking up on tinned food and bottled water
summary: The prime minister suggests preparing for unexpected events. He advises stocking up on tinned food and bottled water. This preparation is due to increasingly common unforeseen circumstances.
